issues.what: the water reads as a grey smoky smear with wispy highlights; there is no ripple structure, petals and blossom clusters sit on top with no wetting or reflection, so the pond looks like fog on frosted glass
issues.fix: give the pond a clear dark body with specular ripple rings, a streak of reflected lamplight, and let petals float with small contact shadows and reflections

issues.what: the ripples are uniform painted concentric ellipses around the lamp glow, and the petals crossing the water do not disturb it; at native size the water reads as a flat grey disc with drawn rings
issues.fix: vary ring amplitude and spacing, break the rings where petals land, and add wet contact glints under the floating petals

issues.where: the waterfall trickle on the base, left of the moss rim (crop 8)
issues.what: the translucent flow reads as smoke or dark claw-like streaks with parallel-line artifacts rather than falling water
issues.fix: render the trickle as a clear refractive water column with highlights that follow the rock and catch the lamp

issues.where: the fence and tulips, left foreground inside the globe (crop 10)
issues.what: picket widths wander, rails merge into the flower heads, and a bubble overlaps a post without interacting, so the geometry is muddled at native size
issues.fix: straighten and separate the pickets, detach the tulip heads from the rails, and seat the bubble clear of the fence

issues.where: petals and glitter particles near the glass and on the surface (crops 6, 11, 12; same in B and C)
issues.what: some petals are flat uniform pink cutouts, the tiny white glitter specks are single-pixel dots of one size and brightness, and nothing has come to rest on the collar or stones
issues.fix: shade the petals with rim light, vary the speck size and intensity across depth, and settle a few petals on the collar, rocks, and glass
